description: Every attempted automated fetch of bank.gov.ua paths (/ua/statistic, /ua/payments/nocash) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.

result.result_summary: Four direct WebFetch attempts on bank.gov.ua and data.gov.ua all returned 403 with no body. This is consistent with bot-defence on plain HTTP clients, not with the pages being dead: the same URLs appear constantly in current search results and are cited by third parties. Treated as UNVERIFIED, not dead.

why_it_matters: The single most important publisher in this cell cannot be collected with a naive HTTP client. Any collector must use a browser engine or realistic headers, and liveness verification must not mark these sources dead on a 403.

description: A search result surfaced the hostname new.bank.gov.ua (path /ua/statistic/supervision-statist), suggesting a staging or redesigned NBU site.

result.result_summary: DNS resolution failed: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND new.bank.gov.ua. The canonical path on bank.gov.ua carries the same content.

why_it_matters: Search indexes may contain stale NBU hostnames; a collector keyed on such a host would silently fail. Pin collection to bank.gov.ua and re-check periodically in case a site migration is actually underway.

description: Could not locate a specific, directly-linked XLSX file for the payment-infrastructure indicators series ('Показники розвитку платіжної інфраструктури') through search alone.

result.result_summary: Targeted uk query for the XLSX returned only PDF reports (oversight, annual reports) and third-party pages. NBU statements confirm machine-readable payment-card data is published, and data.gov.ua exposes XLSX resources for NBU, but the exact bank.gov.ua file URL was not observed and is NOT invented here.

why_it_matters: The concrete download URLs must be resolved by rendering /ua/payments/nocash in a browser or by querying the data.gov.ua CKAN API — search-engine discovery is insufficient for NBU's file assets.

description: The NBU financial-inclusion portal appeared under two different hostnames in search results.

result.result_summary: Both https://finclusion.bank.gov.ua/ and https://fininclusion.bank.gov.ua/ were returned as 'Форум з фінансової інклюзії - НБУ'. Neither was fetched, so which is canonical (and whether one redirects) is unresolved.

why_it_matters: Collection configuration needs the canonical host; recording both risks duplicate sources in the registry.

description: No standalone interactive BI/dashboard product (e.g. a Power BI or Tableau statistical dashboard) for payment statistics was confirmed at the NBU.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced infographics embedded in press releases and section pages, and file-based datasets, but no separate interactive dashboard URL was observed. Absence of evidence only — the NBU site may host one behind the 403.

why_it_matters: If no dashboard exists, the collection design must be file/API-centric; if one does exist behind the block, it would be a high-value structured source and should be looked for during the first browser-based pass.

description: No dedicated Держстат statistical observation on payment instruments, card usage or POS/ATM networks was found. Ukrainian statistical practice appears to leave payment-instrument statistics entirely to the NBU; Держстат touches the topic only indirectly via household expenditure categories and ICT/e-commerce surveys.

result.result_summary: Searches in Ukrainian for Держстат + безготівкові розрахунки returned only household budget survey methodology and expenditure aggregates, no payment-statistics observation.

why_it_matters: Sets expectations: for cell 02, payment statistics are proxies and context, not direct measurement; direct card/POS series must come from the NBU cell.

description: No standalone published АМКУ sectoral market study report specifically on the payment services / acquiring market was located; the substantive market-structure evidence surfaced instead inside case decisions and news releases about the PrivatBank and Oschadbank acquiring cases.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language AMCU search returned news items and a general 'Про проведення досліджень ринків' regulatory index, plus an unrelated market study PDF, but no payments market-study document.

why_it_matters: Collection must target AMCU case decisions and press releases, not a report library, or the acquiring market-share evidence will be missed.

description: Authoritative API documentation for data.gov.ua could not be confirmed. Search results conflicted (one source describes the portal as DKAN-based; an unofficial CKAN mirror exists on GitHub), and no official developer docs page was retrieved.

result.result_summary: English query for data.gov.ua CKAN API returned mostly US data.gov material plus an unofficial mirror repository.

why_it_matters: Machine harvesting of the national catalogue — the main snowball engine for this cell — needs its access contract established before automation is designed.

description: Держстат operates two coexisting domains (stat.gov.ua as the current portal, ukrstat.gov.ua/ukrstat.org as legacy and regional archives). Which content lives where after the migration was not verified, and no URL here has been fetch-tested.

result.result_summary: Both domains returned live-looking results in search; deep-link stability unknown.

why_it_matters: A harvester pinned to one domain risks silent gaps in historical series; deterministic verification pass should test both trees.

description: Finclub.net was fetched directly and, despite being the leading specialist Ukrainian banking news agency, its current front page shows no payment-card, ATM or transaction-statistics coverage — the beat is deposits, lending, insurance and regulation.

result.result_summary: Verified by fetch: sections are Новини / Статті / Пряма мова / Розслідування / Інфографіка; no payment-infrastructure statistics on the observed page.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-weighting an obvious-looking source for A4 payment statistics; it should be tasked for executive quotes and bank strategy instead.

description: No Ukrainian-language trade outlet dedicated specifically to ATM/self-service and cash-handling (the CIT / ATM-deployer beat) was found — searches on банкомат-focused terms returned generic finance portals restating NBU aggregates plus one bank capex story.

result.result_summary: Six uk searches surfaced no ATM-industry-specific Ukrainian trade publication or independent ATM-deployer newsletter.

why_it_matters: ATM fleet economics, replacement cycles and independent deployer activity in UA will have to be reconstructed from bank press releases, procurement records and vendor sources rather than from a trade outlet.

description: Prostobankir.com.ua, historically the main banker-facing analytics portal, presents only http and its indexed analytics pages look dated; current publishing cadence was not established within this pass.

result.result_summary: Listed as a candidate with reduced credibility/confidence and flagged for a freshness check rather than dropped.

why_it_matters: If dormant it is still a valuable pre-war baseline archive for card and channel research; if live it is a high-value B2B source. The distinction changes collection design.

description: A large share of uk-language 'analytics' on cards, POS terminals and ATM counts is verbatim restatement of the same NBU payment-system release, circulating across censor.net, minfin, skilky-skilky, finteco and fixygen within days.

result.result_summary: The same 2025 figures (15.7k ATMs, 558.6k terminals, 9,512.3m card operations, UAH 7,157.2bn) recur across multiple outlets found in one search.

why_it_matters: Counting these as independent corroboration would inflate confidence in a single primary series; the collector must deduplicate by underlying release.

description: No Reuters or Bloomberg article specifically on Ukrainian ATM/cash-in-circulation or card statistics surfaced in this pass, despite both wires being known consumers of Interfax-Ukraine copy.

result.result_summary: Searches returned think-tank and niche-outlet coverage instead; global wires appear to cover Ukrainian payments only episodically (sanctions, scheme blockades, macro).

why_it_matters: Global wires would be the highest-credibility EN channel; their apparent thinness on payment statistics means the cell must rely on trade press plus NBU primary data.

description: No English-language source found giving Ukraine-specific ATM fleet counts or POS terminal counts as a recurring series; only a one-off wartime figure (~3,800 ATMs, 1,500+ branches) cited via a think tank.

result.result_summary: ATM/POS infrastructure numbers in English are anecdotal and undated in secondary coverage.

why_it_matters: ATM/POS installed base is a core A4 metric for Printec; the EN media channel cannot supply it and must be served from NBU statistical tables or vendor reports.

description: This cell is scoped to English-language coverage; Ukrainian-language searches were run as required, but their function here was to surface aliases and English-edition equivalents rather than to add uk-language sources (those belong to cell 11).

result.result_summary: uk query 'Україна платіжний ринок новини англомовні ЗМІ...' surfaced The Paypers, 112.ua/en and GlobalData — i.e. EN assets reachable only via local terms.

why_it_matters: Confirms local-language querying materially improves EN-channel recall and should be retained in the collection routine.

description: Several highest-value EN sources are paywalled or licence-restricted: bne IntelliNews premium wire, Interfax full wire, GlobalData and Euromonitor report bodies.

result.result_summary: Free tiers give headlines and press summaries only.

why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decisions are required before these can be used as a data feed rather than a signal detector.

description: No URL in this slice was fetched for liveness; all entries rest on search-result metadata and snippets.

result.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores only, per the routine's rule that a separate deterministic pass verifies reachability.

why_it_matters: Prevents false 'verified' claims; the Kyiv Independent business-section URL in particular is a structural inference.

description: No evidence found of an NBU-run or NBU-sponsored fintech/open-data hackathon in 2025-2026 despite local-language searching.

result.result_summary: Searches on 'хакатон НБУ фінтех' returned the NBU Fintech Strategy 2025 page, open-banking regulation coverage and data.gov.ua datasets, but no hackathon event pages.

why_it_matters: Hackathons are a classic venue where API specs and data volumes leak; if none exist in UA, the hackathon sub-layer of this cell is empty and effort should shift to conferences and hiring.

description: LinkedIn company pages and LinkedIn Jobs for Ukrainian banks/PSPs/vendors could not be inspected beyond public search snippets.

result.result_summary: LinkedIn URLs surfaced repeatedly (UPC, EMA Association) but content is login-gated and LinkedIn ToS prohibits automated collection.

why_it_matters: LinkedIn is the single richest venue for the 'company announcements naming systems and volumes' half of this cell; without access, that channel must be covered manually or via mirrored press releases.

description: Generic search engines do not index individual Ukrainian job postings well; targeted queries returned board landing pages rather than specific vacancies.

result.result_summary: Queries naming Way4/TranzWare/OpenWay plus Ukraine returned vendor marketing and CVs, not live bank vacancies.

why_it_matters: Hiring signals must be collected by querying the boards' own search endpoints directly, not via web search; this shapes the collection design.

description: No dedicated Ukrainian payments-industry awards programme was found beyond FinAwards; no separate acquiring/ATM-vendor award was identified.

result.result_summary: FinAwards (Minfin) is the only recurring award with payment-acceptance categories surfaced in uk-language search.

why_it_matters: Award coverage for this cell concentrates in one annual programme, so collection can be narrow but must be timed to Feb-Apr.

description: Automated fetch of https://bank.gov.ua/ua/supervision/payment-services/reg-ps returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The page is clearly live (it ranks in search and is linked from multiple NBU sections); the 403 is bot protection, not absence.

result.result_summary: Could not enumerate the exact file names/URLs of the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури downloads from within this run.

why_it_matters: The single most important register in this cell needs a browser-grade collector rather than a plain HTTP fetcher; a naive pipeline would wrongly record bank.gov.ua as unavailable.

description: No published register of authorised open-banking TPPs (AISP/PISP) was located, despite the framework entering into force on 1 August 2025. Searches in both uk and en returned regulatory commentary from law firms but no NBU list URL.

result.result_summary: Open-banking TPP population is currently undocumented in this cell.

why_it_matters: The AISP/PISP list will be the fastest-growing segment of the PSP register; missing it leaves the fintech actor map incomplete.

description: No standalone NBU register specifically of e-money issuers (емітенти електронних грошей) was found as a distinct published list; e-money issuance appears to be handled as a licence type inside the general payment-services authorisation regime under Resolution No. 217.

result.result_summary: E-money issuers must be extracted as a licence-type filter of a broader register rather than collected from a dedicated list.

why_it_matters: Affects collector design: the e-money population is a derived subset, not a separate source.

description: No official register or licence list was found that enumerates ATM or POS terminal deployers/acquirers as such. Registers cover legal persons and their licences, not device estates.

result.result_summary: ATM/POS device data cannot be obtained from the register layer.

why_it_matters: Confirms that ATM/POS statistics must come from the NBU statistics workstream, not from registers; registers only supply the acquirer/issuer entity list to join against.

description: ЄДР open data, including ownership structure and ultimate beneficial owners, was suspended from 2022 and only restored in January 2026, with defence-sector entity data still withheld.

result.result_summary: Beneficial-ownership coverage has a multi-year hole and a residual redaction scope.

why_it_matters: Any ownership time series for 2022-2025 will be incomplete; historical UBO reconstruction may require commercial aggregators that retained pre-2022 snapshots.

description: Repeated uk-language searching for the size of the Ukrainian cash-in-transit / cash-handling market (обсяг ринку інкасації) returned only vendor service pages and bank tariff pages — no association, regulator or consultancy publishes CIT market volume, revenue or cash-processed tonnage.

result.result_summary: No public CIT market-size series found; only company self-descriptions and the NBU licence framework.

why_it_matters: Cash-logistics cost and capacity is a core input for POS/ATM and cash-automation strategy; absent a market figure, sizing must be reconstructed bottom-up from licensee filings (SMIDA/EDR) and NBU cash-turnover data.

description: No Ukrainian grocery or fuel chain (АТБ, Fozzy/Сільпо, Novus, Varus, Фора, ОККО, WOG) was found publishing its own cash-versus-card payment mix. Coverage discusses acquiring costs and cash-at-till services but never a disclosed cash share by chain.

result.result_summary: Chain-level cash/card mix is not publicly disclosed in either language.

why_it_matters: The demand side of cash usage is invisible at merchant level; the cell must rely on NBU trade-revenue aggregates plus survey proxies, or on paid retail panels.

description: No dedicated, currently published Ukrainian consumer survey specifically on cash-vs-card preference was located from GfK Ukraine, KIIS or Gradus; the GfK payment-habits study surfaced only via a third-party Medium retelling, and academic work (Journal of East-West Business, 2025, n=215) sits behind a Taylor & Francis paywall.

result.result_summary: Payment-preference survey evidence is fragmentary, second-hand or paywalled.

why_it_matters: Consumer cash-preference tracking has no stable free primary series; commissioning or purchasing is likely required for a reliable trend.

description: The NBU electronic register of cash-collection licensees and the NBU cash-turnover statistical table were not resolvable to exact deep links from search results; only the regulation PDF, an English press release and the general statistics landing page were obtained. Not treated as dead — assumed live but unverified.

result.result_summary: Register and statistics deep-links unpinned; landing pages recorded instead.

why_it_matters: Automated collection needs stable endpoints; a manual pass on bank.gov.ua is required before scheduling harvesters.

description: Searches combining cash-in-transit, POS terminals and processing in one Ukrainian query returned no single consolidated tender or index; only a specific CIT tender (UA-2021-08-17-006384-a, 'Послуги інкасації та перевезення валютних цінностей') and generic portal pages surfaced.

result.result_summary: Composite topic queries do not map to a composite source; the topics must be pursued as separate CPV/keyword streams inside Prozorro.

why_it_matters: Collection design should not expect a ready-made 'payments procurement' index; it must be built from CPV plus Ukrainian keyword filters over the raw API.

description: Could not confirm via search that Prozorro Market's e-catalogue actually carries CPV 30123600 (cash dispensers / автомати для видачі готівки) or payment-terminal product cards.

result.result_summary: Only general Prozorro Market documentation was returned; no product-level evidence for ATM or POS categories.

why_it_matters: The e-catalogue's usefulness for hardware price benchmarking is a hypothesis until a human checks the CPV tree on the platform itself.

description: No dedicated TED view or filter specifically indexing Ukraine-directed payment/banking-equipment tenders was found via search; only a generic Denmark/EUACI IT-equipment framework example surfaced.

result.result_summary: TED coverage of Ukraine payment hardware must be established by running CPV plus country filters directly on TED, not from a pre-existing index.

why_it_matters: Sets expectations: TED is a low-yield but high-credibility stream for this cell, requiring its own query engineering.

description: No Ukrainian-language donor-procurement aggregator was found that consolidates EBRD/UNDP/World Bank Ukraine notices; donor procurement appears only in English-language portals.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian-language search terms for donor procurement returned domestic Prozorro platforms rather than donor indexes.

why_it_matters: Donor-funded stream must be collected in English; local-language monitoring will systematically miss it.

description: Clarity Project restricted free access to extended Prozorro analytics (reported January 2024); subscription pricing reported roughly UAH 450/day to UAH 33,000/year.

result.result_summary: Deep supplier/competitor analytics on this platform now carries a cost; the free tier is limited.

why_it_matters: Budget and licensing must be planned if Clarity is to be part of the standing collection stack; otherwise fall back to the free Prozorro API plus BI module.

description: Ukrainian banks, including the systemically important ones, do not maintain equity-style investor relations sites with quarterly investor presentations or fact books. Searches for 'investor presentation' and 'інвестиційна презентація' for PrivatBank/Oschadbank/Raiffeisen Ukraine returned no bank-published IR decks.

result.result_summary: No bank-hosted IR presentation decks found; disclosure is limited to statutory IFRS statements, an integrated annual report (PrivatBank), press releases, and the Ministry of Finance's state-bank decks.

why_it_matters: Collection design must target annual reports, press centres and MoF decks rather than an IR calendar; there is no quarterly deck cadence to schedule against.

description: Beyond PrivatBank and monobank, banks generally do not publish absolute card-issued, ATM and POS-estate counts in their statutory reporting. Searches for Ukrsibbank, OTP, Kredobank and Pivdenny surfaced product/locator pages but no published estate statistics.

result.result_summary: Per-bank card/ATM/POS counts are sparse outside the two largest card players; mid-tier banks reveal estate only implicitly via locator maps.

why_it_matters: Bank-level ATM/POS market sizing will have to be reconstructed from locator scrapes and NBU aggregates rather than from disclosure documents.

description: The legacy Raiffeisen Aval reporting archive at ex.aval.ua returned a 'Request Rejected' interstitial in search results.

result.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live, not dead; unverified.

why_it_matters: Historical card/ATM series for Aval may need archive.org retrieval or header-adjusted fetching.

description: The Sense Bank corporate domain (sensebank.ua) and the Oschadbank reporting subsection were inferred from context rather than confirmed by fetch during this pass.

result.result_summary: URLs supplied with reduced confidence; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Two systemically important banks' primary disclosure paths remain to be pinned down precisely.

description: No Ukraine-specific customer case study was located on the global sites of NCR Atleos or Diebold Nixdorf despite targeted en-language searching.

result.result_summary: OEM case-study libraries surfaced CEE examples (e.g. Turkey) but nothing named for Ukraine; Ukrainian OEM presence appears to be mediated entirely through local partners/distributors rather than direct OEM reference marketing.

why_it_matters: The installed-base route for global ATM OEMs in Ukraine must be worked through local partners and bank press releases, not OEM marketing — this changes the collection plan for the ATM hardware segment.

description: The uk-language query for Ingenico/PAX/Verifone official distributors in Ukraine returned almost exclusively North American resellers.

result.result_summary: No Ukrainian authorised-distributor page for the major POS terminal OEMs was identified this run; the only Ukraine-anchored terminal-vendor signals came indirectly via PRRO software certification (Checkbox/Printec, Castles S1F2) and bank acquiring pages.

why_it_matters: POS terminal brand share in Ukraine is currently unobservable from OEM channel pages; the fiscalisation-certification route is the working substitute and should be prioritised.

description: No settled Ukrainian-language term set was found for switch and HSM procurement (payment switch, hardware security module, key management).

result.result_summary: Searches returned English product terminology only; Ukrainian bank/vendor material appears to use the English terms untranslated, and no Ukraine-specific HSM integrator page was found.

why_it_matters: The switch/HSM sub-segment of this cell is currently uncovered in local language; future runs should search transliterations and English-in-Ukrainian forms rather than attempted translations.

description: "Сістем Груп Україна" and "БМС Консалтинг" were probed as suspected bank-IT integrators but neither was confirmed with a bank-facing reference page in this run.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced no corroborating vendor page tying either name to Ukrainian bank projects; they remain unverified actor-map hypotheses, not sources.

why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated integrator entry and flags two names for targeted re-checking against event sponsor lists and registry data.

description: No Ukrainian acquirer, PSP or processor publishes an industry-wide acquiring aggregate (total acquiring turnover, total active merchants, total POS estate). Searches in Ukrainian for 'еквайринг Україна обсяг транзакцій кількість торговців' returned only product/tariff pages and single-firm claims.

result.result_summary: Operator-side data exists only as scattered self-reported KPIs; the only market-wide aggregation is regulator-side (NBU), which sits outside this cell.

why_it_matters: The cell must be collected firm-by-firm and reconciled; any market total built from operator disclosures will be a bottom-up estimate with double-counting risk (bank acquirer vs PSP-on-top-of-acquirer).

description: IBOX (IBOX Bank / IBOX terminal network) produced no usable volume or terminal-count disclosure in the Ukrainian-language operator search; results returned nothing for this name.

result.result_summary: Zero hits for IBOX volume data in the uk-language query that surfaced NovaPay, EasyPay and iPay.ua figures.

why_it_matters: IBOX Bank's 2023 licence revocation likely removed its disclosures from circulation; the cash-in terminal segment therefore has a hole where a formerly large operator sat, and successor operators need separate identification.

description: Merchant counts and throughput figures for the strongest domestic e-commerce acquirers (RozetkaPay ~28k-35k merchants, ~350k operations/day; Solidgate ~350 clients, ~50% YoY growth) exist only as marketing claims or interview statements, with no audited or regulator-filed counterpart located.

result.result_summary: Numbers are real and citable but unverifiable and inconsistently defined across firms and dates.

why_it_matters: Any trend series built from these must be flagged as self-reported; definitional drift (merchants vs contracts vs entrepreneurs) will otherwise create false growth.

description: No standalone Ukrainian BNPL operator with public volume disclosure was found; BNPL in Ukraine is delivered as a bank credit product (PUMB «Сплата частинами», PrivatBank «Оплата частинами», monobank «покупка частинами») and only qualitative uplift claims (~+30% purchase frequency) surfaced.

result.result_summary: BNPL market size for Ukraine is not published by providers in either language.

why_it_matters: BNPL cannot be sized from operator disclosures in this run; it must be inferred from bank consumer-lending reporting instead.

description: No established Ukrainian-language term or operator brand was located for a domestic instant/QR account-to-account payment scheme run by a private provider; the searches surfaced only card-scheme tokenisation and bank apps, with instant payments framed as an NBU/regulator initiative.

result.result_summary: Local-language coverage of the QR/instant-payments sub-segment of this cell is effectively empty at the operator level.

why_it_matters: The cell brief explicitly names QR/instant-payment providers; this sub-segment may not yet exist commercially in Ukraine, which is itself a finding, but it needs a dedicated follow-up with NBU instant-payment-system participant terminology.

description: The one English-language source promising systematic acquiring transaction value/volume series (GlobalData 'Ukraine Cards and Payments') is a paid commercial report; only the abstract is accessible.

result.result_summary: Headline framing accessible, underlying series not.

why_it_matters: Budget decision required if a validated market-level series is needed; otherwise the run must rely on NBU plus bottom-up operator aggregation.

description: Neither Visa nor Mastercard appears to publish a Ukraine-specific quantitative dataset (transaction counts, volumes, acceptance-point counts) — only narrative press releases built on commissioned consumer surveys with small samples (e.g. n=679 online shoppers in Kyiv and Kharkiv).

result.result_summary: Searches in uk and en surfaced only survey-based press releases and no downloadable Ukraine data file from either scheme.

why_it_matters: Scheme-level quantitative market share for Ukraine must be sourced from the NBU card-market statistics, not from the schemes themselves; scheme releases should be treated as sentiment/behaviour indicators with weak sampling.

description: No Ukrainian-language UnionPay country press room or ua-locale site was found; UnionPay Ukraine material exists only in English on unionpayintl.com and is dated 2018-2020.

result.result_summary: English queries returned company news and market updates; a targeted Ukrainian-language UnionPay corporate channel could not be identified.

why_it_matters: UnionPay's Ukrainian footprint is likely dormant or wound down; treat its acceptance/ATM figures as historical baselines, not current, and do not expect ongoing local-language disclosure.

description: No Ukraine-specific SWIFT country page or SWIFT-published Ukraine statistics series was identified within this cell's searches; Ukrainian cross-border messaging context surfaces instead through NBU SEP/SEPA-alignment material.

result.result_summary: Queries on SWIFT/SEPA/instant payments returned NBU pages and third-party fintech blogs, not a SWIFT primary source scoped to Ukraine.

why_it_matters: Cross-border rail intelligence for Ukraine should be anchored on NBU SEP/IPS publications and EU/SEPA (EPC) decisions rather than on an assumed SWIFT country disclosure.

description: Both scheme interchange disclosures are date-stamped or CDN-path PDFs (Mastercard's filename embeds 26-11-2021); the current editions may sit at URLs not discoverable by search.

result.result_summary: Found one Visa IRF PDF and one dated Mastercard Ukraine PDF; no stable index page listing all editions was located.

why_it_matters: Collection must discover the parent directory/landing page rather than hard-coding a PDF URL, or the tracker will silently freeze on a stale rate table.

description: Base URLs for nabu.ua, amcu.gov.ua and the Rada bill-card path were inferred from actor identity rather than retrieved from search results, and no fetch was attempted.

result.result_summary: Actors confirmed by name in coverage; canonical entry URLs not directly observed in results.

why_it_matters: These three entries need the deterministic liveness pass to confirm the entry points before any collector is pointed at them.

description: No dedicated Ukrainian ATM-deployer or cash-in-transit (інкасація) industry association was found. Searches in Ukrainian for інкасація/перевезення цінностей/банкомати asociation terms returned only individual CIT service companies (cit.net.ua, cit-security.ua), the Wikipedia article on інкасація, and NBU cash-handling regulations.

result.result_summary: Domestic ATM/CIT self-regulation appears to run through NABU/AUB working groups and the NBU rather than a standalone trade body; ATMIA Europe is the nearest substitute.

why_it_matters: The ATM/cash-logistics segment — core to the ATM POS data and cash usage topics — has no association-level survey source in Ukraine, so those metrics must come from the regulator, vendors, or bank disclosures instead of cell #8.

description: No single authoritative Ukrainian e-commerce association with published online-payment statistics was located. Searches surfaced 'Ukrainian E-Commerce Expert' (described as a communication platform, LinkedIn presence only), Ukrainian E-Commerce Awards, and event brands (Ukrainian eCommerce Day, organised by the fintech association UAFIC) rather than a member-based association publishing market data.

result.result_summary: E-commerce payment statistics appear to be produced by RAU, UAFIC, the shopping-centre council and commercial platforms rather than by an e-commerce trade association.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-investing crawler effort hunting for a non-existent 'Ukrainian E-commerce Association' data feed; redirects e-commerce payment coverage to RAU/UAFIC/UCSC.

description: https://nabu.ua/ua/karta-sayta.html returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, and https://fintechua.org/ returned an essentially empty document body (client-side rendered).

result.result_summary: Neither is evidence the sites are dead; both are hypotheses of rate-limiting and JS-rendering respectively.

why_it_matters: Collection design for these two high-priority sources must budget for polite pacing (NABU) and headless rendering (UAFIC); a naive crawler would misclassify them as unavailable.

description: NABU appears under two Ukrainian names — 'Незалежна асоціація банків України' (historic, founded 2011) and 'Національна асоціація банків України' (current usage), sharing the domain nabu.ua and USREOU code 37924657. Separately, the acronym НАБУ collides with the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine.

result.result_summary: One legal entity, two names in circulation, plus a high-noise acronym collision.

why_it_matters: Query design must disambiguate: pair НАБУ with 'банків'/'банківськ' terms or use nabu.ua site-restricted search, otherwise anti-corruption-bureau results will dominate and dedup logic may split one actor into two.

description: The Ukrainian Credit-Banking Union surfaced on two domains, kbs.org.ua and ukbs.org.ua, without a clear indication of which is canonical or current.

result.result_summary: Canonical domain unresolved in this pass; neither was fetched.

why_it_matters: Requires manual resolution before scheduling collection, and the union's activity level (last publication date) should be checked before treating it as a live source.

description: The Всеукраїнська асоціація фінансових компаній (ВАФК) has a Facebook page and corporate-registry cards (opendatabot, youcontrol, vkursi) but no independent website was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Non-bank financial companies' association is visible as a legal entity but not as a publisher.

why_it_matters: Non-bank payment institutions are the fastest-growing licence category; if their association does not publish, that segment's association-level intelligence must be sourced from NBU registers and individual firms instead.

description: Searched specifically for a dedicated Ukraine POS terminal / ATM market report from Mordor Intelligence and IMARC. Mordor has country-level POS reports for Cyprus, Croatia and a Europe-wide report, but no Ukraine-specific POS or ATM report surfaced; no IMARC Ukraine payments report surfaced either.

result.result_summary: No standalone commercial Ukraine ATM/POS hardware market report identified in this pass.

why_it_matters: ATM/POS installed-base and vendor-share data for Ukraine will likely have to come from NBU statistics, acquirer disclosures and regional (Europe/CEE) commercial reports rather than a Ukraine-specific bought report.

description: Deloitte's 'Overview of Ukraine's banking sector 2023-2024' is cited in Ukrainian academic literature as a 38-page Kyiv publication, but a direct search of deloitte.com/ua did not surface the report's landing page or PDF URL.

result.result_summary: Report existence is well-attested via citation; canonical URL unresolved.

why_it_matters: This is likely the single most valuable free Big Four sector deliverable for the cell; a verification pass should crawl the Deloitte Ukraine insights index directly rather than relying on search engines.

description: Ukrainian-language searching produced almost no results for commercial *paid* payments-market reports written in Ukrainian; uk-language queries returned academic journal articles (economyandsociety.in.ua, nayka.com.ua), consultancy insight hubs and rating agencies instead.

result.result_summary: The paid Ukraine payments-report market appears to be transacted almost entirely in English by foreign publishers; Ukrainian-language commercial research is concentrated in survey houses, rating agencies and Big Four local offices.

why_it_matters: Shapes collection design: for uk-language commercial intelligence, target rating agencies, survey houses and press-release wires, not report storefronts.

description: No Ukraine-focused specialist payments-market research boutique (an equivalent of a regional payments consultancy publishing recurring UA card/acquiring market reports) was identified. Coverage is split between global publishers, Big Four locals, rating agencies and generalist survey houses.

result.result_summary: No dedicated Ukrainian payments-research house found.

why_it_matters: Confirms there is no single commercial substitute for NBU primary statistics; aggregation must be assembled across several actor types.

description: RA Rurik's quarterly 'Аналітичний огляд банківської системи України' PDF series was only surfaced in an old edition (Q4 2014); whether the series continues post-2022 is unknown.

result.result_summary: Series may be discontinued; treat as unverified rather than dead.

why_it_matters: If still live it is a free, structured, system-level quarterly aggregate; if dead the effort should shift to Standard-Rating's diagnostic studies.

description: No BIS CPMI Red Book / CPMI statistics coverage of Ukraine was found. Ukraine is not a CPMI member jurisdiction, so BIS comparative payment statistics (cards, POS, ATM per capita) appear not to include UA.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced no BIS statistical table containing Ukraine payment-system data; BIS coverage seems limited to member jurisdictions.

why_it_matters: Analysts expecting a BIS benchmark for Ukraine must fall back on IMF FAS and World Bank GPSS/Findex; a BIS citation for UA would likely be a misattribution.

description: ECB payments statistics (Payments Statistics / SDW-ECB Data Portal) cover EU/EEA reporting agents; Ukraine is not a reporting country, so no ECB-published UA card/POS series was identified.

result.result_summary: No Ukraine series located in ECB comparative payments statistics during this pass.

why_it_matters: ECB data is still useful as an EU peer benchmark for Ukraine's convergence narrative, but cannot supply Ukrainian figures themselves.

description: The EBRD Project Summary Documents listing for Ukraine is a JavaScript filter interface; a stable machine-readable endpoint for the filtered project list was not confirmed in this pass.

result.result_summary: URL with filterCountry=Ukraine identified but not proven to return server-rendered rows.

why_it_matters: Automated harvesting of EBRD Ukraine project disclosures may need a headless browser or an undocumented JSON API; this should be tested before relying on it.

description: USAID Ukraine financial-sector programme materials are largely mirrored on NBU pages; USAID's own document repository (DEC) and programme sites were not directly confirmed reachable in this pass, and USAID restructuring since 2025 raises the risk of link rot for programme archives.

result.result_summary: Programme content found chiefly via bank.gov.ua rather than usaid.gov/dec.usaid.gov.

why_it_matters: Historical POS/acceptance statistics published by USAID projects may vanish; mirrors and early archiving are advisable.

description: No Ukrainian-language version of the World Bank Global Findex or IMF FAS Ukraine data tables was found; these datasets appear to be English-only.

result.result_summary: uk-language searches returned academic and government commentary about financial inclusion, not localised IFI datasets.

why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language monitoring must target NBU/MoF republications and academic secondary sources rather than the IFI datasets themselves.
